title: Foundations & local platform
summary: Cargo workspace, a one-command local stand-in for every AWS service, and the shared conventions every later epic builds on.
goal: By the end of this epic, `docker compose up` gives a working fake AWS on the laptop, the AWS SDK for Rust is proven against it, and the workspace has a shared domain model, config, errors, logging and CI.
success_criteria: All four infrastructure containers start healthy with one command and survive restarts with their data.
Example programs talk to S3, SQS and DynamoDB stand-ins using the official AWS SDK for Rust.
Every PR is checked by CI (fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests).
The telemetry envelope and categories exist as tested Rust types in stratum-core.
rust_learning_outcomes: Structs, enums, derive macros and serde
